description: Use when someone asks for a room’s floor area, perimeter, volume or carpet and skirting amounts, or what a size such as 3 × 4 m or 12 × 12 ft means (a box room, a single or double bedroom). Handles L-shaped rooms and bay windows.

ceiling_height_cm.description: The ceiling height, for the volume (cm).

part2_length_cm.description: An L-shaped room’s second part: its length along the main room (cm).

room_width_cm.description: The room’s width (along the window wall) (cm).

shape.description: rectangle, or l_shape (a second part on the right-hand wall, flush with the far corner).
